title: Patch-Switching Criterion for RESEARCH Loop Termination
summary: Pirolli and Card's information-foraging patch-switching applied at research-loop-end: a three-way verdict (continue this patch, switch patch, switch to synthesis) against marginal yield versus opportunity cost, with a practitioner-elicited expected observation and a reflexive-versus-genuine pre-mortem discrimination. Late patch-additions accommodated. Skill-Structure Layer in /rdd-research.

links.note: Skill-Structure Layer application at research-loop-end; the verdict line in the research log is the audit-bearing artifact
ADR-100 bounds items per loop; this ADR bounds loops. Pre-triage at loop-end records under "Findings and orchestrator triage"
